decisions: Admission waits while the batch has no area and a map file of the batch is still being drafted, because the site is a context pin of every reader job (proposal step 2). Part 0 is queued in the publishing transaction when that wait does not apply and the active cap allows; otherwise it is planned and the dispatcher admits it.
A part failed because its context moved goes back to planned and is enrolled again under the fresh pin (new job id); accepted parts are never rewritten.
